descriptions.0: I’m a developer from Malang, Indonesia, with a computer science degree from Institut Teknologi dan Bisnis ASIA Malang. My work spans web, mobile, and the APIs that connect them.
descriptions.1: As a Senior Frontend Developer, I build features for the Smartlink and Groapp ecosystems, improve architecture and performance, and work closely with product and backend teams. From 2022 to July 2026, I led a frontend engineering team, mentoring developers and shaping technical standards.
